title: Seagrove "Utopian Village" 3319 East County Highway 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps from the beach- Gulf views- Private heated pool and spa **Pool and spa are heated together and available October 1-May 1 for $25 per day**- Professionally decorated- Abundant natural light through window and door transoms- Free WiFi- 6 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Outstanding location meets coastal elegance with this professionally decorated Seagrove Beach retreat—only steps from the beach! Utopian Village is a spacious 2,700-square-foot 30A getaway, boasting 6 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms that comfortably sleeps 20. Savor early-morning coffee from sprawling Gulf-view balconies, unwind on the sugar-soft beaches, and spend the afternoons lounging poolside with friends and family. Seaside and Rosemary Beach are a short bike ride away!Enter into this gorgeous 3-story coastal haven through its delightful entryway, where 3 spacious bedrooms are nestled on the first floor. The lovely primary bedroom features a comfy king bed, TV, and private bathroom, alongside 2 other equally inviting guest bedrooms with king beds and TVs—each bedroom offers direct outdoor access. A tall, stunningly white fireplace anchors this home’s outdoor oasis, perfectly positioned by the sparking pool and attached sitting spa. The covered outdoor kitchen and dining area offer ample seating under ceiling fans with a propane grill and outdoor TV—perfect for hosting! After a busy beach day, rinse off sandy feet in the outdoor shower, toss towels into the first-floor laundry room, and unwind on Adirondack chairs beneath the shade of coastal trees.With crisp white interiors and warm wood floors, the second-floor great room exudes a bright and airy charm as natural light cascades through large windows and transoms. The living area combines subtle coastal charm with comfort, featuring 2 cozy loveseats, 2 pinstriped armchairs, and a 65” TV with a sound bar. Cook, prep, and entertain in the sleek white kitchen, featuring pristine countertops, a deep farmhouse sink, and high-end Samsung appliances. Savor quick bites at the 3-person breakfast bar, or gather around the 8-seat dining table for sit-down dinners. Then, enjoy endless Gulf sunset views from the balcony, complete with plush furniture and a picnic table. When it’s time to retire, there are 2 guest bedrooms on this floor boasting king beds and TVs, alongside a shared bathroom.The third-floor bunk room is a dream come true for kids, featuring 5 twin-over-twin beds, a bathroom, TV, and balcony access!Utopian Village offers unforgettable memories on the Emerald Coast! With parking for 4 vehicles—plus 6 adult bikes and a low speed vehicle—exploring Scenic 30A is a breeze. For beach access, enjoy a short 1-minute stroll down Dothan Avenue to the boardwalk. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 20):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:- Bunk Bedroom: Five Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove "Utopian Village" 3319 East County Highway 30A Santa Rosa Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-047164 Bedrooms 6 Beds 15 Sleeps 20 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps from the beach - Gulf views - Private heated pool and spa **Pool and spa are heated together and available October 1-May 1 for $25 per day** - Professionally decorated - Abundant natural light through window and door transoms - Free WiFi - 6 adult bikes - 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Outstanding location meets coastal elegance with this professionally decorated Seagrove Beach retreat—only steps from the beach! Utopian Village is a spacious 2,700-square-foot 30A getaway, boasting 6 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms that comfortably sleeps 20. Savor early-morning coffee from sprawling Gulf-view balconies, unwind on the sugar-soft beaches, and spend the afternoons lounging poolside with friends and family. Seaside and Rosemary Beach are a short bike ride away! Enter into this gorgeous 3-story coastal haven through its delightful entryway, where 3 spacious bedrooms are nestled on the first floor. The lovely primary bedroom features a comfy king bed, TV, and private bathroom, alongside 2 other equally inviting guest bedrooms with king beds and TVs—each bedroom offers direct outdoor access. A tall, stunningly white fireplace anchors this home’s outdoor oasis, perfectly positioned by the sparking pool and attached sitting spa. The covered outdoor kitchen and dining area offer ample seating under ceiling fans with a propane grill and outdoor TV—perfect for hosting! After a busy beach day, rinse off sandy feet in the outdoor shower, toss towels into the first-floor laundry room, and unwind on Adirondack chairs beneath the shade of coastal trees. With crisp white interiors and warm wood floors, the second-floor great room exudes a bright and airy charm as natural light cascades through large windows and transoms. The living area combines subtle coastal charm with comfort, featuring 2 cozy loveseats, 2 pinstriped armchairs, and a 65” TV with a sound bar. Cook, prep, and entertain in the sleek white kitchen, featuring pristine countertops, a deep farmhouse sink, and high-end Samsung appliances. Savor quick bites at the 3-person breakfast bar, or gather around the 8-seat dining table for sit-down dinners. Then, enjoy endless Gulf sunset views from the balcony, complete with plush furniture and a picnic table. When it’s time to retire, there are 2 guest bedrooms on this floor boasting king beds and TVs, alongside a shared bathroom. The third-floor bunk room is a dream come true for kids, featuring 5 twin-over-twin beds, a bathroom, TV, and balcony access! Utopian Village offers unforgettable memories on the Emerald Coast! With parking for 4 vehicles—plus 6 adult bikes and a low speed vehicle—exploring Scenic 30A is a breeze. For beach access, enjoy a short 1-minute stroll down Dothan Avenue to the boardwalk. Book now!
